hero.lede: Evidence-based chiropractic care for back pain, sports injuries, and everyday stiffness — most new patients get their first adjustment within 48 hours.
hero.card_body: Your first visit includes a full assessment and a plan you'll actually understand — no long-term contracts.

services.heading: Care built around how you actually move
services.sub: Every plan starts with a real exam, not a generic protocol.

items.name: Spinal adjustments
items.desc: Manual and instrument-assisted adjustments for chronic and acute back or neck pain.

items.name: Sports injury rehab
items.desc: Recovery plans for runners, lifters, and weekend athletes, built with your season in mind.

items.name: Prenatal chiropractic
items.desc: Webster-technique certified care to ease pregnancy-related back and pelvic pain.

items.name: Therapeutic massage
items.desc: Licensed massage therapy paired with your adjustment plan to speed up recovery.

items.name: Posture & ergonomics
items.desc: Desk-setup and movement assessments for chronic neck and shoulder tension.

items.name: Pediatric chiropractic
items.desc: Gentle, low-force adjustments for kids, from infants to teens.

process.heading: What your first three weeks look like
process.sub: Most patients notice a difference well before treatment ends.

steps.title: Book & complete intake
steps.desc: Fill out your history online before you arrive — your first visit is exam time, not paperwork time.

steps.title: Full assessment
steps.desc: Posture, movement, and a review of any imaging you bring, so treatment targets the actual cause.

steps.title: First adjustment
steps.desc: Most patients are treated the same visit as their assessment, not sent home to "wait and see."

steps.title: A plan with an end date
steps.desc: You'll get a written care plan with a target number of visits, reassessed every few weeks.
